title: Implement semantic-nonempty validation

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 semantic-nonempty validation capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current Python forest has two narrower, reusable fail-closed controls: SemanticBindingAdmission@1 rejects missing or sentinel record bindings, and AnalyticalChangeTransformer@1 rejects an empty caller-supplied source span. Neither defines PCSM semantic nonemptiness over a canonical current CodeIR/source identity, an aggregate current source-map CID, exact resolved file/node/span, and the requested semantic witness. PCSM-051 and PCSM-052 independently record that SourceMapResolver@1, SourceLinkReceipt@1, the aggregate source-map CID, and the forest linker are absent. Under this dispatch's exact receipt-only authority, the smallest versioned delta is therefore an honest unavailable/non-promoted disposition; no competing semantic authority, source mutation, or test relaxation is permitted.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The required general suite passes, but it covers structured model-output decoding rather than a PCSM semantic-nonempty package. No versioned PCSM semantic witness schema, canonical source-map binding, or package-specific positive and negative vector surface exists at this head.

evidence_legend.estimated: A calculated approximation; it cannot establish semantic nonemptiness, current-tree identity, schema binding, canonical CID binding, or test success.
evidence_legend.simulated: A controlled provider-environment execution; it corroborates but cannot replace fixed-toolchain validation or authorize mutation or promotion.
evidence_legend.unavailable: A required identity, capability, or result absent from the authoritative environment; it is neither zero nor passing.

limitations: This task is receipt-only under exact declared-output authority; no implementation or test source was changed.
SemanticBindingAdmission@1 validates caller task-record fields, not Python source semantics or the exact PCSM source forest.

AnalyticalChangeTransformer@1 rejects an empty supplied span and has CIDv1 replay identities, but it neither resolves that span from canonical PCSM identity nor proves semantic nonemptiness in the forest.
Without a current aggregate source-map CID, treating a Git tree/blob, AST span, caller string, or alias as semantic evidence would weaken the required authority boundary.
The required suite passes under the fixed-toolchain environment, but it provides no package-specific positive or negative coverage.
No aliases are accepted as canonical source identity and no M2/M3 mutation, generated-source mutation, or automatic source materialization is authorized.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
